summary: Tested the three Court-compare additions (Comparison PDF, Talking Points, Sharing Alert emails) and confirmed previous Court flows still work. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter_court_compare_pdf_points_alerts.py — GET /api/court-path/compare/pdf 409 before ready (parent1 safety_off, parent2 waiting with safety-flagged co-parent, parent3 not_shared); 200 application/pdf with Content-Disposition filename SA_CoParents_Side_by_Side_Comparison.pdf; content contains 'Side-by-Side Comparison', 'Case: PAIR-DEMO-01', 'Areas of Alignment/Difference/Child-Focused Needs', 'Jordan Parent and Casey Parent' (caller-first from parent3, 'Casey Parent and Jordan Parent' from parent4), child answer 'Dr. Lee, Northside Pediatrics'; PUT /api/portal/state {court_legal_name:'Jordan Q. Legalname'} → appears in PDF. POST /api/court-path/compare/talking-points 409 before ready; when ready returns compare payload with talking_points {items[{area,source,text}], generated_at, stale:false}, 6 items (<=8), each text<=280 chars, area ∈ difference rows; parent4's GET /api/court-path/compare returns identical items (shared via court_talking_points per court_key). Mutating parent4 cp_report_history snapshot in Mongo → talking_points.stale=true for parent3; PDF then omits 'Talking point:' lines (checked). Alerts: after reseed, parent3 shares → parent4 gets invite_sent_at in court_compare_alerts (background task, within ~15s); parent4 shares → ready_sent_at for BOTH; toggle parent3 off then on, and re-share while already sharing, do not change timestamps (weekly limit + non-event). Safety: toggling parent2 share off/on never writes a court_compare_alerts doc for safety-flagged user_5ce04f1049a4 (parent1); parent1 share attempt still returns safety_off/shared=false. Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter_court_compare_drafts.py 12/12 pass. Frontend (parent3@test.com UI login, sacoparents_last_door='court', /dashboard, legal modal accepted): court-tool-compare-pdf before ready has sub 'Available once both parents share' and clicking does NOT download (info toast path); after API-forcing both to share and reloading, sub reads 'Side-by-side results for mediation' and clicking downloads SA_CoParents_Side_by_Side_Comparison.pdf. Opening court-spot-pillar-difference popup (JS click) shows exactly one data-testid='court-compare-pdf' button that downloads the PDF, plus court-talking-points-generate; after click the button becomes court-talking-points-refresh and 6 court-talking-point-{i} rows appear under the differing areas (opener-0 example: 'We both want smooth transitions for our child...'). Logging in as parent4 and opening the same popup shows court-talking-points-refresh with 6 rows and NO generate button — i.e. shared across parents (ordering differs per caller because the difference list is caller-first; backend test confirms the item TEXT set is identical). No horizontal overflow at 390 or 1920; court-tool-sync carries 'lg:col-span-2'. Court picture ignored per instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: court_compare.py build_compare recomputes load_results+basis+_compare_scores on every GET /compare poll (ready state). With both parents viewing the popup frequently, this re-reads cp_report_history, self_assessment_history and child_needs_assessments on every call. Consider a short per-case cache keyed on (court_key, basis) similar to how talking_points reuses basis.

court_compare_alerts._alert stores *_error on email failure but never retries; a user who hits a transient Resend 5xx on first-share will wait 7 days before the next notification attempt. Consider: only set the timestamp on success, and set *_error without the sent_at so the next share event retries within the week.

court_compare.py set_share recomputes `_is_sharing(other)` AFTER the current user is marked sharing; notify_share(both_sharing=…) is correct, but the share response then returns build_compare which does another load_results+scores. Minor duplicate work; could pass data forward.

court_compare_pdf._header truncates each parent name to 26 chars in the per-row header but the top block prints the full name. Fine for A4/Letter, but a court_legal_name longer than 26 chars will look truncated in the table while full in the top. Document or widen.

UI: the Comparison PDF 'tool under the picture' click behaviour (info toast only) when not ready is handled by useCourtCompare.downloadPdf; worth adding a disabled visual state so the button looks inert when !ready instead of showing a toast on click.
test_credentials: parent1@test.com (safety_off), parent2@test.com (waiting on ALIGN-SA-2026), parent3@test.com + parent4@test.com (PAIR-DEMO-01, left in 'ready' sharing state at end). All passwords TestPass123!.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran seed_court_compare_pair.py at start, during the stale test (to restore baseline), and left both parent3+parent4 sharing (ready) at the end. court_talking_points for PAIR-DEMO-01 contains 6 freshly generated openers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter_court_compare_pdf_points_alerts.py (11 cases) and the earlier /app/backend/tests/test_iter_court_compare_drafts.py (12 cases). Both re-seed via seed_court_compare_pair.py and leave data in a usable state. For the alerts test, use the real user_ids from the seed output (user_f6130bc2835f=parent3, user_888a80257d90=parent4, user_5ce04f1049a4=parent1). PDF text extraction uses zlib.decompress on each FlateDecode stream between 'stream\n' and '\nendstream'. For the frontend, API-side manipulation of share state is the fastest path — ui_login via /login (click 'Sign in with email' if visible, else form is already shown) then set sacoparents_last_door='court' and goto /dashboard. court-tool-compare-pdf shows the sub via [data-testid='court-tool-compare-pdf-sub']. The Difference popup is court-spot-pillar-difference and requires JS click (toast overlay). The talking-points item ORDER differs per caller because difference rows are enumerated caller-first in compare; verify equality by TEXT SET rather than index.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. Observed UI quirk: in the Difference popup, parent3's row-0 opener does not equal parent4's row-0 opener because each parent's difference list is sorted/ordered relative to their own ratings (caller-first). The underlying court_talking_points.items set is identical across parents (verified in backend test by comparing item TEXT lists after reload) — the UI just renders each opener matched by area to that parent's row ordering.
